sample_unit: patients (prospective validation cohort with decompensated cirrhosis)

links.outcome: Model AUC versus serum creatinine standard for HRS diagnosis in prospective cohort
links.effect: ML model AUC 0.994 (95% CI 0.985-0.998) versus serum creatinine AUC 0.803; p < 0.001
links.quote: This represented a substantial and statistically significant improvement over serum creatinine-based diagnosis (AUC = 0.803; p < 0.001).

unlisted_practices: Cost-effectiveness (ICER) evaluation of ML model against standard diagnosis
SHAP interpretability analysis and decision curve analysis for clinical utility

screen.reason: Prospective cohort validation of an XGBoost predictive model for hepatorenal syndrome, including evaluation of temporal robustness and cost-effectiveness, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
